Plotting params

```{r}
sqrt_breaks = c(1,4,9,16,25,36,50,64,81)
breaks <- 10^(-10:10)
minor_breaks <- rep(1:9, 21)*(10^rep(-10:10, each=9))

SEsmooth=F
my_alpha=0.2
bun_limits = c(1,100)
crea_limits = c(10,1000)

mortality_threshold = 0.05
```


## Load data

Analysis dataset
```{r}
sm_data_analysis = readr::read_csv(file = 'Data/Analysis_data.csv')
sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis %>% mutate(
  Coma = ifelse(Coma_Final==1,'Yes','No')
)
sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis %>%
  mutate(Weight_category = as.factor(Weight_category),
         COUNTRY=as.factor(COUNTRY),
         SITE_STUDY=paste(SITEID, STUDY,sep = '_'),
         SITE_STUDY = as.factor(SITE_STUDY))

cols_check = c("RFSTDTC","SITEID","ARM","COUNTRY","SEX","Age","Died",
               "Time_to_death","Capillary Refill Time_sec","Head Circumference_cm",
               "Heart Rate_beats_min","Height_cm","Mid-Upper Arm Circumference_cm",
               "Respiratory Rate_breaths_min",
               "Systolic Blood Pressure_mmHg","Temperature_C",
               "Weight_kg","Oxygen Saturation_%","Diastolic Blood Pressure_mmHg",
               "Coma_Final","Respiratory distress","Shock",
               "Hypoglycaemia","Seizure","Jaundice",
               "Blood in urine","Anemia","Hyperparasitaemia",
               "Anuria","GCS_tot","BCS_tot","para_ul","Malaria_RDT","PfHRP2_ng_ml",
               "Malaria_Positive","Glucose_mmol_L","Hb",
               "Lactate","Base Excess_mmol_L","Creatinine_umol_L",
               "HCT","Leukocytes_10_9_L","Platelets_10_9_L",
               "Urea Nitrogen_mmol_L")
vis_miss(sm_data_analysis %>% select(all_of(cols_check)),warn_large_data = F)
```


```{r BUN_Creatinine_ratio}
sm_both = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(BUN), !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L))
```

## Mortality models

### Non parametric

chatgpt version

```{r bun_groups_mortality}
sm_dat_bun = sm_data_analysis %>% 
  filter(!is.na(BUN), !is.na(Weight_category), 
         INCLUDE_CC_ANALYSIS) 
# Bin BUN into quantiles (e.g., 5 groups)
bun_cuts = c(.5, 5, 10, 20, 200)
sm_dat_bun <- sm_dat_bun %>%
  mutate(BUN_groups = cut(BUN, breaks = bun_cuts,include.lowest = T))  
levels(sm_dat_bun$BUN_groups)=c("<5","(5,10]","(10,20]",">20")

# Summarize by BUN quantile and Coma
summary_df <- sm_dat_bun %>% filter(!is.na(Coma_Final)) %>%
  group_by(Coma, BUN_groups, Weight_category) %>%
  summarise(
    mortality = mean(Died),
    n = n(),
    se = sqrt(mortality * (1 - mortality) / n),
    lower = 100*(mortality - 1.96 * se),
    upper = 100*(mortality + 1.96 * se),
    mortality = 100*mortality,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
summary_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = BUN_groups, y = mortality, group = Coma, colour = Coma)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Blood urea nitrogen (mmol/L)",
    y = "Mortality (%)",
    size = "Number of Patients",
    title = "Mortality by urea nitrogen level, coma status, and weight"
  ) + geom_hline(yintercept = 100*mortality_threshold)+
  theme_minimal()+facet_wrap(vars(Weight_category))
```



```{r creat_groups_mortality}
sm_dat_creat = sm_data_analysis %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L), !is.na(Weight_category),
         !is.na(Died_28D),!is.na(Coma),
         INCLUDE_CC_ANALYSIS)
creat_cuts = c(10,65, 130, 265, 2000)
sm_dat_creat <- sm_dat_creat %>%
  mutate(Creat_groups = cut(Creatinine_umol_L, breaks = creat_cuts,include.lowest = T))  
levels(sm_dat_creat$Creat_groups)=c("<65","(65,130]","(130,265]",">265")

# Summarize by Creatinine quantile and Coma
summary_df <- sm_dat_creat %>% filter(!is.na(Coma)) %>%
  group_by(Creat_groups, Coma, Weight_category) %>%
  summarise(
    mortality = mean(Died),
    deaths = sum(Died),
    n = n(),
    se = sqrt(mortality * (1 - mortality) / n),
    lower = 100*(mortality - 1.96 * se),
    upper = 100*(mortality + 1.96 * se),
    mortality = 100*mortality,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
summary_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = Creat_groups, y = mortality, group = Coma, colour = Coma)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Creatinine (umol/L)",
    y = "Mortality (%)",
    size = "Number of Patients",
    title = "Mortality by creatinine level, coma status, and weight"
  ) + geom_hline(yintercept = 100*mortality_threshold)+
  theme_minimal()+facet_wrap(vars(Weight_category))
```


### Parameteric models


```{r mortality_models, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
### ************** Creatinine model **************
table(sm_dat_creat$SITE_STUDY,sm_dat_creat$`Died within 28 days`)
table(sm_dat_creat$SITEID)
mean(sm_dat_creat$`Died within 28 days`=='Yes')
table(sm_dat_creat$Weight_category)

mod1 <- brm(bf(Died_28D ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L),by=Weight_category,k=4)+Coma+Weight_category+(1|SITE_STUDY)),
          data = sm_dat_creat ,
          family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
          iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 10, refresh = 250)
sm_dat_creat$mod1_preds=colMeans(fitted(mod1, summary = FALSE,re_formula = NA))
sm_dat_creat %>% ggplot(aes(x=Creatinine_umol_L, y = mod1_preds, colour = Weight_category))+geom_point()+scale_x_log10()+theme_minimal()+
  geom_hline(mortality_threshold)+geom_vline(xintercept = 265)
# fit separate models for each weight category
mod1 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L),k= 3)+Coma_Final+s(SITE_STUDY, bs='re'), 
           family = 'binomial(link=log)',
           data = sm_dat_creat %>% filter(Weight_category=='(0,25]'))

mod2 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L),k= 3)+Coma_Final+s(SITE_STUDY, bs='re'), 
           family = 'binomial(link=log)',
           data = sm_dat_creat %>% filter(Weight_category!='(0,25]'))
pred1=predict_gam(mod1,tran_fun = exp,series = "Creatinine_umol_L",
                  values = list(STUDY= -1, Coma_Final=c(0,1),
                                Creatinine_umol_L=10^seq(1.3,2.8,length.out=20))) 
pred1$Weight_category='(0,25]'
pred2=predict_gam(mod2,tran_fun = exp, series = "Creatinine_umol_L",
                  values = list(STUDY= -1, Coma_Final=c(0,1),
                                Creatinine_umol_L=10^seq(1.3,2.8,length.out=20))) 
pred2$Weight_category='(25,100]'
preds = rbind(pred1, pred2)

h1=sm_dat_creat%>%ggplot(aes(x = Creatinine_umol_L,colour = Weight_category))+
  scale_x_log10(limits=crea_limits) + geom_density()+theme_minimal()+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))+
  ggtitle(label = paste('No coma (n=',nrow(sm_dat_creat),')',sep = ''))
p1=preds %>%
  plot(comparison='Weight_category')+ylim(0,.25)+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=crea_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+xlab('Creatinine (umol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 265)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))

## brms version - penalise RE on SITEID
# xx= sm_dat_creat %>% filter(STUDY=='TRACT')
# ## Question around Black water fever: is this impacting mortality/BUN or Creatinine values?
# m2_tract <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L))),
#           data = sm_dat_creat %>% filter(STUDY=='TRACT'), 
#           family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
#           iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 10, refresh = 500,
#           control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99))
# plot(m2_tract$data$`log10(Creatinine_umol_L)`,colMeans(fitted(m2_tract, summary = FALSE)))

m2_creat <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L), by=Weight_category) + Coma_Final + (1|STUDY/SITEID)),
                data = sm_dat_creat, 
                family = bernoulli(link='log'), cores = 4, seed = 17,
                iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 10, refresh = 500)
sm_dat_creat$M2_preds = colMeans(fitted(m2_creat, summary = FALSE))
sm_dat_creat %>% ggplot(aes(x=Creatinine_umol_L, y = M2_preds, colour = Weight_category))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=crea_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  xlab('Creatinine (umol/L)')+ylab('Probability of death')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 265)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)

### ************** BUN model **************
sm_dat_bun = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(BUN), !is.na(Coma_Final))#, STUDY != 'TRACT') 
sort(table(sm_dat_bun$STUDY))
dim(sm_dat_bun)
mean(sm_dat_bun$Died)
table(sm_dat_bun$Weight_category)


# fit separate models for each weight category
mod1 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN),k=4)+s(SITEID, bs='re'), 
           family = 'binomial',data = sm_dat_bun %>% filter(Weight_category=='(0,25]'))
mod2 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN),k=4)+s(SITEID, bs='re'), 
           family = 'binomial',data = sm_dat_bun %>% filter(Weight_category!='(0,25]'))
pred1=predict_gam(mod1,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "BUN",
                  values = list(SITEID= -1, 
                                BUN=10^seq(0,1.45,length.out=20))) 
pred1$Weight_category='(0,25]'
pred2=predict_gam(mod2,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "BUN",
                  values = list(SITEID= -1, 
                                BUN=10^seq(0,2,length.out=20))) 
pred2$Weight_category='(25,100]'
preds = rbind(pred1, pred2)

h2=sm_dat_bun%>%ggplot(aes(x = BUN,colour = Weight_category))+
  scale_x_log10(limits=bun_limits) + geom_density()+theme_minimal()+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))+
  ggtitle(label = paste('No coma (n=',nrow(sm_dat_bun),')',sep = ''))

p2=preds %>%
  plot(comparison='Weight_category')+ylim(0,.25)+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=bun_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+xlab('BUN (mmol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))

grid.arrange(h1, h2, p1,p2,nrow=2, ncol = 2, heights = c(1, 1.2))

## BRMS version
m2_bun <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(log10(BUN), by=Weight_category, k=3) + Coma_Final + (1|STUDY/SITEID)),
              data = sm_dat_bun, 
              family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
              iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 2)

sm_dat_bun$M2_preds=colMeans(posterior_epred(m2_bun,re_formula = NA))
sm_dat_bun %>% ggplot(aes(x=BUN, y = M2_preds, colour = Weight_category))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=bun_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  xlab('BUN (mmol/L)')+ylab('Probability of death')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)

```



Models using imputation

```{r single_imputation}
impute_creatinine = gam(log(Creatinine_umol_L) ~ s(log(BUN)) + s(sqrt(Weight_kg)) + s(SITEID,bs='re'),
                        data = sm_data_analysis)
summary(impute_creatinine)
preds_creatinine = exp(predict(object = impute_creatinine, newdata = sm_data_analysis))
# make imputed value column
sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L_Imputed=
  ifelse(is.na(sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L),
         preds_creatinine,
         sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L)
plot(sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L, preds_creatinine,log = 'xy')
lines(1:1000, 1:1000)

impute_bun = gam(log(BUN) ~ s(log(Creatinine_umol_L)) + s(SITEID,bs='re'), data = sm_data_analysis)
summary(impute_bun)
# make imputed value column
preds_bun = exp(predict(object = impute_bun, newdata = sm_data_analysis))
sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed = 
  ifelse(is.na(sm_data_analysis$BUN), preds_bun, sm_data_analysis$BUN)
plot(sm_data_analysis$BUN, preds_bun,log = 'xy')

plot(sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L_Imputed, sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed,log = 'xy')
```


BRMS model on imputed data

```{r}
sm_data_analysis_final = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(STUDY!='TRACT', !is.na(Weight_category))
m2_creat <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L_Imputed), by=Weight_category) + (1|SITEID)),
                data = sm_data_analysis_final, 
                family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
                iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 10, refresh = 500,
                control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99))

m2_creat2 <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L_Imputed), by=Weight_category) + (1|STUDY)),
                 data = sm_data_analysis_final, 
                 family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
                 iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 10, refresh = 500,
                 control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99))

sm_data_analysis_final$M2_preds_creatinine = colMeans(posterior_epred(m2_creat2,re_formula = NULL))

sm_data_analysis_final$M2_preds_creatinine = colMeans(posterior_epred(m2_creat,re_formula = NA))
p1=sm_data_analysis_final %>% ggplot(aes(x=Creatinine_umol_L_Imputed, y = M2_preds_creatinine, colour = Weight_category))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=crea_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  xlab('Creatinine (umol/L)')+ylab('Probability of death')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 265)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)


m2_bun <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(log10(BUN_Imputed), by=Weight_category) + (1|SITEID)),
              data = sm_data_analysis_final, 
              family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
              iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, thin = 10, refresh = 500,
              control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99))
sm_data_analysis_final$M2_preds_bun = colMeans(posterior_epred(m2_bun,re_formula = NA))
p2=sm_data_analysis_final %>% ggplot(aes(x=BUN_Imputed, y = M2_preds_bun, colour = Weight_category))+
  geom_point()+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=bun_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  xlab('BUN (mmol/L)')+ylab('Probability of death')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)
grid.arrange(p1,p2)
```


Use the weight normalised Creatinine and BUN to predict outcome

```{r}
sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis%>%filter(!is.na(Weight_kg), STUDY != 'TRACT', Coma_Final==0)

mod_weight_bun = gam(log2(BUN_Imputed) ~ s(Weight_kg), data = sm_data_analysis)
summary(mod_weight_bun)

sm_data_analysis$BUN_baseline_log2 = predict(mod_weight_bun)
plot(sm_data_analysis$Weight_kg, sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed, log='y')
lines(1:100, 2^predict(mod_weight_bun, newdata = data.frame(Weight_kg=1:100)), 
      col='red', lwd=3)
sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed_FC = log2(sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed)-sm_data_analysis$BUN_baseline_log2

summary(lm(BUN_Imputed_FC ~ SEX + Coma_Final + STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis))
plot(sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed, sm_data_analysis$BUN_Imputed_FC)

gam_bun <- gam(Died ~ s(BUN_Imputed_FC, by=Weight_category) + s(STUDY,bs='re'),
               data = sm_data_analysis, 
               family = binomial())
summary(gam_bun)

m2_bun <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(BUN_Imputed_FC, by=Weight_category) + (1|STUDY)),
              data = sm_data_analysis, 
              family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
              iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, thin = 10, refresh = 1000)
sm_data_analysis$M2_preds=colMeans(posterior_epred(m2_bun,re_formula = NA))
sm_data_analysis %>% ggplot(aes(x=BUN_Imputed_FC, y = M2_preds, colour = STUDY))+
  geom_jitter()

m2_bun <- brm(bf(Died ~ s(BUN_Imputed_FC, by=STUDY)),
              data = sm_data_analysis, 
              family = bernoulli(), cores = 4, seed = 17,
              iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, thin = 10, refresh = 1000)
sm_data_analysis$M2_preds=colMeans(posterior_epred(m2_bun,re_formula = NA))
sm_data_analysis %>% ggplot(aes(x=BUN_Imputed_FC, y = M2_preds, colour = STUDY))+
  geom_jitter()
```

```{r}
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+xlab('Creatinine (umol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 265)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))

### ************** BUN model **************

# fit separate models for each weight category
mod1 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN_Imputed),k=4), 
           family = 'binomial',data = sm_no_coma %>% filter(Weight_category=='(0,25]'))
mod2 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN_Imputed),k=4), 
           family = 'binomial',data = sm_no_coma %>% filter(Weight_category!='(0,25]'))
mod3 = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN_Imputed),k=4, by = Weight_category), 
           family = 'binomial',data = sm_no_coma)

pred1=predict_gam(mod1,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "BUN_Imputed",
                  values = list(BUN_Imputed=10^seq(0,1.45,length.out=20))) 
pred1$Weight_category='(0,25]'
pred2=predict_gam(mod2,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "BUN_Imputed",
                  values = list(BUN_Imputed=10^seq(0,2,length.out=20))) 
pred2$Weight_category='(25,100]'
preds = rbind(pred1, pred2)

h2=sm_no_coma%>%ggplot(aes(x = BUN_Imputed,colour = Weight_category))+
  scale_x_log10(limits=bun_limits) + geom_density()+theme_minimal()+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))+
  ggtitle(label = paste('No coma (n=',nrow(sm_no_coma),')',sep = ''))

p2=preds %>%
  plot(comparison='Weight_category')+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=bun_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+xlab('BUN (mmol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,.25), xlim = c(1,30))

q2=predict_gam(mod3,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,
               series = "BUN_Imputed",
               values = list(BUN_Imputed=10^seq(0,2,length.out=20))) %>%
  plot(comparison='Weight_category')+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=bun_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 15)+xlab('BUN (mmol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5), "cm"))

grid.arrange(h1,h2,p1,p2,ncol=2)
```


## Half thresholds??


```{r}
sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    STUDY_Weight = paste(STUDY, Weight_category,sep = '_'),
    Above_BUN_threshold = 
      case_when(!is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&BUN>10 ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&BUN<=10 ~ 'NO',
                !is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&BUN>20 ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&BUN<20 ~ 'NO'),
    Above_Creat_threshold = 
      case_when(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&Creatinine_umol_L>(265/2) ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&Creatinine_umol_L<=(265/2) ~ 'NO',
                !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&Creatinine_umol_L>265 ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&Creatinine_umol_L<=265 ~ 'NO'))%>%
  arrange(STUDY, Weight_category)


aggregate(Died ~ Above_BUN_threshold + STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis,
          FUN = function(x) c(round(100*mean(x)), sum(x),length(x)))

lyt <- basic_table() %>%
  split_cols_by('STUDY') %>%
  split_cols_by('Weight_category') %>%
  split_rows_by('Above_BUN_threshold')%>%
  summarize_row_groups() %>%
  analyze("Died", afun = function(x) c(sum(x),mean(x)), format = "xx (xx.x%)")
build_table(lyt = lyt, df = sm_data_analysis%>%filter(!is.na(BUN)))

lyt <- basic_table() %>%
  split_cols_by('STUDY') %>%
  split_cols_by('Weight_category') %>%
  split_rows_by('Above_Creat_threshold')%>%
  summarize_row_groups() %>%
  analyze("Died", afun = function(x) c(sum(x),mean(x)), format = "xx (xx.%)")
build_table(lyt = lyt, df = sm_data_analysis%>%filter(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L)))
```
